style: warm children's storybook illustration in soft gouache and watercolour, painterly texture, visible paper grain, golden Mediterranean light, gentle and dignified, full scene composition, no text, no lettering, no frame, no border

characters.father: the father, a kind Middle Eastern man in his late fifties with a grey-streaked full beard, deep warm eyes and smile lines, wearing a cream linen under-tunic, a russet-brown wool robe and a leather belt, simple leather sandals
characters.younger: the younger son, a lean nineteen-year-old Middle Eastern man with wavy dark-brown hair, a short patchy beard and tired hopeful eyes, wearing an ochre-yellow tunic with a brown sash and worn leather sandals
characters.older: the older son, a broad-shouldered Middle Eastern man in his early thirties with a short black beard, a stern brow and guarded eyes, wearing a slate-blue tunic and a dark-red cloak
characters.estate: the family estate in first-century Judea: a honey-coloured stone house with a flat roof and an arched wooden door, surrounded by olive trees and a dusty road under a wide warm sky
characters.distant: a distant foreign market town with terracotta rooftops, crowded dusty streets, camels and merchants, dry hills behind it
characters.pigs: a muddy pig pen on a foreign farm with a rough wooden fence, olive-green hills and a grey overcast sky

pages.title: Meet the Family
pages.scene: a gentle group portrait of the three family members standing together in front of the stone house, full figures, warm afternoon light

pages.title: The Request
pages.scene: the younger son holds out an open hand to ask his father for his inheritance; the father listens with sorrow and love; a leather pouch of coins rests on a low stone table between them

pages.title: The Far Country
pages.scene: the younger son walks into a noisy foreign market town with a travel bag over his shoulder, coins spilling from his hand, merchants and revellers around him

pages.title: The Pig Fields
pages.scene: the younger son, ragged and hungry, sits among pigs by a wooden fence, reaching toward the pods in a muddy trough, his clothes torn and dirty

pages.title: He Came to His Senses
pages.scene: the younger son kneels alone on the dusty road at dusk, hands clasped, looking back toward the distant lights of his father's house

pages.title: The Father Runs
pages.scene: the father runs down the dusty road with his robe lifted, arms open, while the weary younger son lifts his head in disbelief; the stone house glows behind them

pages.title: Restored
pages.scene: the father places a fine white-and-gold robe on the younger son's shoulders and a gold signet ring on his finger; sandals wait on the ground; servants prepare a feast in the courtyard

pages.title: The Older Brother
pages.scene: the older son stands alone at the edge of the field at sunset, arms crossed, jaw tight, watching music and lamplight spill from the family house

pages.title: The Father's Plea
pages.scene: the father steps outside the house and pleads gently with the older son, one hand on his arm, their faces close in the warm doorway light

pages.title: The Open Door
pages.scene: the father stands in the open doorway with arms wide, the younger son beside him and the older son hesitating at the threshold, warm light pouring out into the evening
